notes: Mazda Australian Tier 1 BEV research checked 15 October 2026: the supported current maker lists contain four exact named versions, 6e E35 GT/Atenza and CX-6e E35 GT/Azami. All four reuse existing catalogue identities; no new version or colour/interior pseudo-grade is added.

CarExpert and CarsGuide current Mazda brand lists support 6e and CX-6e; MX-30 occurs as discontinued/historical. These are independent brand-level checks, not the two independent whole-market lists needed for global C1.

The current Mazda BEV hub advertises 6e available now/test-drive today, but CX-6e coming soon and open for pre-order. CX-6e is proposed as announced_provisional + preorder; the existing buyer label remains Order open or arriving. Its two records leave the legacy on-sale denominator while remaining C1 current-list eligible from explicit fresh maker preorder evidence. No generic reporter-scope change is proposed.

The exact Melville Mazda E35 Azami GR advertisement, stock 11397703, remains separate seller New-listing evidence. No present unsold physical possession, accepted factory allocation, delivered specification or manufacturer model year is inferred. The historical July/September delivery forecasts are not fulfilled delivery evidence.

Exact public GT driveaway-from offers supply rung-3 prices; Atenza/Azami state-specific driveaway-from configurator prices supply rung 4 tagged NSW. WA is A$1,000 higher for every grade. Maker MLP lacks explicit on-road treatment and remains visible supplemental historical evidence rather than rung 1.

All 17 core fields have a labelled figure, with secondary acceleration Reported and unranked. Cargo remains source-specific: 6e brochure 337 L VDA versus webpage 336 L unspecified, CX-6e brochure 363 L VDA versus webpage 468 L unspecified. The source-labelled VDA observations remain visible and unranked. Gross/usable battery capacity and warranty retention threshold are not invented.
